meta.rationale: Iteration 0 — limited-vocab baseline. One linear pipeline: data.jsonl is sliced by `bun run regen --min-count 150 --max-count 400 --n 4000` into a ~400-emoji vocab (data/train.jsonl + data/eval.jsonl + data/labels.json), the small char-CNN (ENCODER_CHANNELS [64, 96], dilation [1, 2], MAX_TEXT_LEN 32) trains emoji + fusion heads. Two gates only: exact-keyword Acc@1 (CLDR probe) and short-text emoji Acc@1 (emoji.eval, best fusion variant). Everything else is deferred until these are green.
